ModMetaData.name: Configurable Quality - Progression preset
ModMetaData.author: KyleMHB
ModMetaData.description: Optional Configurable Quality settings for Progression. Select Configurable Quality - Progression in Auto Mod Config to apply. Enables standard quality-assignment groups and production choices with Mild effect factors. Resolves the pack's prisoner-jumpsuit and Dubs Bad Hygiene quality exclusions at startup. Existing explicit item exceptions take precedence. Keeps market-value scaling enabled and vanilla-quality removal disabled. This preset changes Configurable Quality settings only. Applying it replaces that mod's configuration snapshot; export your existing settings first.
